front.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / 3D environment modeling reference. Output exactly ONE complete floating island in ONE camera view, NOT a collage/contact sheet/multi-panel. A beautiful premium tactile stylized 3D miniature matching the Radio Archipelago reference: warm ivory limestone cliffs and architecture, mint patinated copper, restrained warm brass, coral cloth accents, dark cypress foliage, golden wildflowers, soft moss, rich delicate material detail and soft warm daylight. No characters, UI, text, labels, compass, arrows, glowing game tiles, ocean, horizon, scenery background or clouds obscuring geometry. Neutral very pale warm-grey studio background. All rock bottom tips and tree/mast tips fully visible, 12% margin. One connected main island, avoid a swarm of detached debris. Large clear shapes suitable for modeling; beautiful crafted detail, not simplified low-poly primitives.
IMPORTANT PLAYABLE TERRAIN: a continuous generously wide pale stone road, visibly distinct from the grassy/rocky surroundings, forms ONE CLOSED SMOOTH LOOP around landmarks. Use the supplied plan to guide its footprint: one physical road, reused across several song passes, NOT multiple nested/parallel lap roads. No square90-degree corners, hairpin/U-turn, zigzags or central crossing. A180-degree heading change is spread across roughly half the island. Low stone edging/grass shoulders, clear sight lines, width for three future game lanes. The road is a modeling/landscape corridor, NOT blue/coral stepping tiles. It closes smoothly behind the landmark, with no dead ends. Ignore colored entry/exit dots and any dashed guide line: do not paint those marks onto the island. Modelers will scale the terrain later; an example60–90 second song revisits this same road. Do not write duration text into the image.
